name: Downtown 23 B 2BDR
headline: The Neat Nostalgic 2BDR Apt. @ Cairo's Downtown (23B)
summary: This nostalgic 2 bedroom apartment is located at the heart of Downtown Cairo, 250 meters away from the iconic Tahrir Square. The studio is an 8 minute walk from the Egyptian Museum and is surrounded with all kinds of restaurants, gift shops and cafes. The apartment features 2 comfortable queen size beds, a 55 inch smart TV, a cozy bathroom and a fully loaded kitchenette with a sofa bed.

description.Space:
This 2 bedroom apartment features 2 rooms each with a queen size comfortable bed and a nice small balcony! It also features a sofa bed and a fully loaded kitchenette, small dining table, microwave, a stove top with cooking utensils, a kettle and a Nespresso coffee machine. Additionally, guests can enjoy a 55 inch smart TV with AirPlay built-in for further personal entertainment. 

Please note the following: 
- Smoking is only allowed in the balcony or outside the building (a fine of $100 will be imposed when smoking indoors) 
- Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests will be granted entry. 

The styling of the apartment is tailored to give the guests an authentic experience of Cairo's Downtown.

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire apartment.
description.Interaction:
We are more than happy to answer all of your questions 24/7. Guests can text and call anytime they need help and our team will be there in about 30 mins to solve any issue immediately.

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Neighborhood:
Cairo's Downtown is a busy neighborhood packed with a lot of places to explore and enjoy:

- The Egyptian Museum is an 8 minute walk.
- Tahrir Square is a 3 minute walk.
- Cairo International Airport is a 35 minute drive.
- Giza Pyramids is a 35 minute drive
description.Transit: We provide concierge services that include airport transfers and private day tours.

agreement:
Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 150 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 

Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

No complaints.

بصراحة على كثر ما زرت القاهرة وسكنت في أماكن كثيرة، وفي وسط البلد تحديدًا، يظل هذا المسكن من أمتع وأريح التجارب اللي مريت فيها؛ الشقة حميمية وونيسة فعلًا.

المصعد ممتاز، والماء ما انقطع ولا لحظة طوال فترة السكن، وهذا شيء نادر في مساكن وسط البلد، الأسرة مريحة، وحجم الشقة ممتاز، والصالة أوسع وأشرح من الصور.

عزل الصوت حلو مرة بالنسبة لي، تفتح البلكونة تسمع أجواء المدينة، وبمجرد ما تسكرها يختفي أغلب الصوت، ومستوى الأمان عالي جدًا، الغرفة مقفلة برمز، والقسم اللي فيه ثلاث غرف مستقلة مقفل بمفتاح، مع وجود بواب للعمارة، وكل هذا يعطي شعور بالاطمئنان.

النظافة ممتازة، الأثاث جديد، التكييف شغال بكفاءة، وأدوات المطبخ جيده جدًا، الموقع استراتيجي وسياحي بامتياز وقريب من كل شيء تقريبًا، والمنطقة حيوية وخدماتها ممتازة.

التواصل كان مثالي، والاستجابة سريعة جدًا، لدرجة إنهم كانوا يتابعون معي بأنفسهم ويتأكدون إن كل شيء تمام وإن التجربة ما ينقصها شيء، شكرًا لهم على هذا الاهتمام المهم جدًا 🙏🏻🩵✨ ..

وأهم نقطة، السعر جدًا جدًا مناسب مقابل التجربة، أكيد خيار راح أكرره في زياراتي القادمة للقاهرة بإذن الله ?
